title: TYSA — Teach Yourself Anything 自適應學習 Harness
resourceType: Electron adaptive learning app / agentic teaching harness
purpose: 先診斷學習者已知與未知的概念，再建立依賴關係學習地圖，逐步教學、檢查理解並修復混淆，最後透過練習與知識圖譜支援跨 Session 學習。
recommendation: 適合研究個人化 AI 教練與 Communication Gym：參考 Measure → Plan → Teach → Practice、概念依賴圖、使用者推理紀錄、漸進提示與跨 Session 知識圖譜。教學成效未獨立驗證。

architecture.stack: Electron + React/Vite + Hono + engine; npm workspaces/Turborepo
architecture.providers: Meta Muse, Ollama, other model providers
architecture.data: Local learning records and knowledge graph; cloud model requests send selected context to provider

verificationNotes: README lists Meta Muse and Ollama integration as working, while SAM 3.1 and Muse Image remain in progress.
README says desktop installers are not code-signed.
Local storage does not guarantee offline processing: cloud model calls and Meta dictation send data externally.
